justification: Pipeline (under-construction) thermal generation capacity by expected commissioning year, faceted by status (likely-to-be-commissioned vs on-hold). Distinct from installed-capacity-mw which measures COMMISSIONED nameplate capacity already on the grid; this measures FUTURE additions not yet generating. Country grain (all-India aggregate). Calendar-year time axis (publisher ships 2011-2031 with a 2022 gap preserved verbatim).
